svg.title: Allocate a $35,000 Reference Startup Plan across Four Buckets
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-35000-reference-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $35,000 Reference Startup Plan across Four Buckets; subtitle: Lean $10,000, reference $35,000, and expanded $60,000 USD launch plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values depict the $35,000 central/reference startup budget within the canonical $10,000–$60,000 USD range. Each bucket also specifies lean and expanded allocations; all three plans use 40%, 30%, 20%, and 10% shares and sum exactly to $10,000, $35,000, and $60,000 respectively. These are illustrative cash allocations, not accounting capitalization instructions or additional annual costs. Expanded startup funding does not automatically activate the Scaled pod.; caption: Lean: $4,000 + $3,000 + $2,000 + $1,000 = $10,000. Reference: $14,000 + $10,500 + $7,000 + $3,500 = $35,000. Expanded: $24,000 + $18,000 + $12,000 + $6,000 = $60,000. Budget continuing funding separately for the canonical 3–12 months to first deal and $2,500–$14,000 USD monthly opex range; startup capital alone does not guarantee sufficient runway.; stages: label: Original content and evidence; value: $14,000 reference; $4,000 lean; $24,000 expanded; 40%; numeric value: 14000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 of the $10,000 lean plan, $14,000 of the $35,000 reference plan, or $24,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Fund original testing, commissioned writing, editing, and documented media licenses.; label: Technical publishing foundation; value: $10,500 reference; $3,000 lean; $18,000 expanded; 30%; numeric value: 10500.0; detail: Allocate $3,000 of the $10,000 lean plan, $10,500 of the $35,000 reference plan, or $18,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Fund templates, hosting setup, backups, access controls, and initial crawl remediation.; label: Measurement and commercial setup; value: $7,000 reference; $2,000 lean; $12,000 expanded; 20%; numeric value: 7000.0; detail: Allocate $2,000 of the $10,000 lean plan, $7,000 of the $35,000 reference plan, or $12,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Fund attribution setup, reporting connectors, partner materials, and contributor agreement preparation.; label: Unspent working reserve; value: $3,500 reference; $1,000 lean; $6,000 expanded; 10%; numeric value: 3500.0; detail: Allocate $1,000 of the $10,000 lean plan, $3,500 of the $35,000 reference plan, or $6,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. The reference reserve covers 1.4 months at $2,500 monthly opex or 0.25 months at $14,000. Reserve cash is not an incurred expense; avoid counting the same funded activity again as an additional cash need.
